assumption: OBR March 2024 temporary energy price shock scenario applied against the weaker OBR March 2026 baseline headroom posture.
interpretation: The same OBR-style energy shock that was absorbable in the 2024 scenario becomes a headroom-breaching shock when applied to the March 2026 baseline.
caution: This is a deterministic delta model using recorded OBR scenario values and March 2026 headroom. Live oil-market overlays require separate source receipts.
